answer: Anchor each identity to one iris scan: enrollment captures a liveness-checked iris, stores only an unlinkable hash, and rejects any duplicate. A plume of fake accounts collapses at enrollment, because one eye can anchor exactly one identity and forging an iris needs a living person, not a script. Each epoch, a random whisper of identities must pass a fresh live scan, and a mismatch burns the identity and slashes its vouchers. Clones cannot share eyes, so the cost of a sybil spiral rises with every fake body, while honest agents enroll once and keep their standing.
